issues.why: About 10 cups of filling plus 32 oz of tots (roughly 80+) will not fit in a single tight layer in an unsized skillet or Dutch oven, so the tots cannot crisp.
issues.fix: Transfer the filling to a 9x13 dish (or name a 12-inch skillet and cut the tots to about 20 oz), and say the tots may be lightly overlapped.
